entry.title: Shentu v0.2.4
entry.content:
• Rules move to their own format, checked in CI, starting with 33 rules.
  • accounts_audit reports shared SSH keys, ld.so.preload and PAM modules that belong to no package.
  • processes flags cryptominers.
  • Patrol reports one line per webshell.

Rules: 33 added, 0 removed.

entry.title: Shentu v0.2.3
entry.content: • app_code_audit: an offline audit of the applications' own files.

entry.title: Shentu v0.2.2
entry.content: • package_vulns reports each actively exploited CVE once.

entry.title: Shentu v0.2.1
entry.content:
• shentu bot: talk to Shentu from Telegram, with guarded pairing and four ranges of levels.
  • Usage tracking and an optional monthly AI budget.
  • Round 2 of the model comparison: 14 models, 11 scenarios.

entry.title: Shentu v0.2.0
entry.content:
• One command from install to running: a guided setup.
  • Site survey and an application dependency scan.

entry.title: Shentu v0.1.1
entry.content:
• package_vulns marks actively exploited vulnerabilities (CISA KEV).
  • Slack and Discord webhooks.
  • Security invariant tests, a prompt-injection suite and govulncheck before each release.

entry.title: Shentu v0.1.0
entry.content: • First release: shentu chat and shentu patrol for Linux servers, with shentu setup for a local model or an API key.
